objective: Choose POST or continued WAIT separately for each empty bid/ask rung using expected incremental whole-portfolio terminal value

actions.post: submit now, then follow the frozen continuation policy on all future empty-slot decisions
actions.wait: skip this decision, then follow exactly the same frozen policy, including repeated waiting
actions.never_reference: same prefix and same continuation on other rungs, but keep this rung empty for the remaining window

targets.delta: qpost - qwait, local selection diagnostic only
targets.terminal: 60.2s joint portfolio cash plus inventory; native placement/cancel/notice timing and pending fills
targets.clipping: none; v1's +/-10 clipping removed because it changes the economic expectation being estimated
targets.cost_convention: inherited gross simulated value, no fee/rebate or invented inventory-penalty change

policy: POST iff qpost_hat > 0 and qpost_hat >= qwait_hat; positive ties post; nonpositive/nonfinite/missing input waits; reevaluate every50ms; no cooldown or legacy guard veto
keeper: neutral KEEP with identical engine safety cancels in every branch and replay arm; integration with the other session's learned keeper requires relabeling under that keeper
population: neutral no-cancel POST/KEEP entry generations; first generation sampled1/2, later generations1/32 by outcome-independent hash; one row per reference generation
waiting_state_support: suppress only the sampled rung from its neutral birth for a hash-assigned age0/50/100/200/400/800/1600/3200/6400/12800/25600/51200ms, then probe its first legal opportunity; three branches share the complete prefix and client state; age is sampling only, never an execution retry timer
exclusions: unsampled, probe not reached, missing input and engine constraints retained as statuses; no fill/outcome filtering
features: v1's69 causal features plus idle_age_ms and side_price_change_while_empty; same raw and side-aligned signals, known inventory/exposures; optimized entry features checked against original implementation
model: pinned LightGBM params and200 rounds; side-specific post/wait regressors; no hyperparameter tuning
support_checks: at least1000 actions and two training dates per side, at least100 nonzero targets per learned head; require actual tree splits and varying predictions; FLAT bootstrap wait value is structurally zero, not fitted

chronology.bootstrap: full consumed Oct23/24 labels under FLAT entry continuation -> pi1 post-admission heads
chronology.continuation_labels: all later consumed days labeled under the SAME frozen pi1; pi1 never learns from them
chronology.final_models: each pi2 fold fits both heads using continuation-label days strictly before its test day; first fold trains Oct25/26
chronology.calibration: none; economic thresholds fixed, no calibration outcome tuning
chronology.interpretation: finite policy improvement under a learned continuation, not convergence or optimality

portfolio: 6rungs per side,30shares per order,1500-share hard exposure cap, shared inventory and price reservations
basic_screen: positive absolute M50 PNL with/without <100ms fills; beat every nonflat comparator pooled and on at least4/5 days at each clock under both age treatments; no higher integrated squared inventory at M50; both sides must pass local matched timing null
local_null: 500 count-matched selections within UTC day/side/hour/rung; evaluate paired joint-portfolio POST-minus-WAIT value, never sum labels as portfolio PNL; selected absolute POST value and delta both positive, delta exceeds null95th percentile; require at least30 selected and30 withheld actions per side
portfolio_null: only if basic screen passes:200 accepted M50 random quota-controlled admissions per market window, matching candidate submission counts EXACTLY per side (therefore also hour); neutral keeper and full coupled replay; predetermined coin-rate mixture0.25/0.5/0.75/0.95/1.0; reject unmatched counts, maximum2000 attempts per window; cannot accept with missing draws/windows
acceptance: basic_screen AND complete matched portfolio null AND candidate total PNL exceeds null95th percentile with and without <100ms fills; skipped/refused null always means no acceptance
intervals: 1000 UTC-day bootstrap draws only after five complete consumed development days; descriptive, not forward validation
execution: supervised user service, codex/core8 via run_light,4GiB AS cap and2GiB RSS guard; preserve artifacts; source freeze before historical work; identity-checked ExecStopPost resumes older size queue
limitations: neutral-keeper experiment, not combined learned keep/pull performance
finite learned-policy improvement can still have policy/state distribution shift; no optimality claim
queue/fill simulator and gross economics remain unvalidated
SCHEDULED/TIMER inherit historical LODO guard inputs and are exploratory comparators
candidate has seen-day development only; any forward test requires separately frozen untouched complete days
